## Background

Primary workflows should be usable without relying on a mouse or color alone.

## Goal

Audit daily check-in, month switching, reward redemption, reading-plan expansion, and settings dialogs for keyboard and screen-reader usability.

## Acceptance criteria

- Every interactive control is reachable in a logical tab order.
- Focus indicators remain clearly visible on light and colored backgrounds.
- Icon-only buttons have useful accessible names and tooltips where needed.
- Dialogs move focus inside on open and restore focus on close.
- Status is communicated with text or accessible labels, not color alone.
- Add focused automated checks where practical and document manual verification.

Please keep visual changes consistent with the existing interface.
